# reselling_rootserver (Data Source)

Looks up an existing rootserver by `id` or by exact `hostname`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reselling_rootserver" "legacy" {
  hostname = "legacy.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String)

### Read-Only

- `cluster_id` (String)
- `cores` (Number)
- `disk` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ipv4_addresses` (List of String)
- `ipv6_subnets` (List of String)
- `labels` (List of String)
- `location_id` (String)
- `os_version_id` (String)
- `primary_ip` (String)
- `ram` (Number)
- `status` (String)
